dedupe_keys.name: cropharvest global crop labels and satellite features

description: CropHarvest is NASA Harvest's open agricultural-label benchmark assembled from 21 contributing datasets. The repository describes 95,186 labels, including 33,205 multiclass labels, with 70,213 labels paired with remote-sensing features. Label geometry is published as GeoJSON, and model inputs include monthly Sentinel-1, Sentinel-2, SRTM and ERA5 features in HDF5 files. Coverage spans multiple countries and source-specific observation periods, not a uniform global survey. Public data and code are free under CC-BY-SA-4.0, confirmed by the linked dataset's registry metadata. A limitation is heterogeneous sampling and label detail across original sources; the availability of a label does not guarantee the same features or crop taxonomy everywhere. CropHarvest can calibrate crop-area inputs for agricultural water-demand and food-supply simulations, complementing subnational yield observations in CY-Bench (data-cy-bench-subnational-crop-yield-benchmark). The repository supplies dataset classes and benchmark procedures and cites the 2021 NeurIPS dataset paper. No agricultural records, feature arrays or pretrained models were downloaded.
